# Cyber Kings: GENERATED by _dev/scripts/struggles/gen_world_struggles.py - change the generator, not this file.
# Struggle ending decisions, modelled on vanilla 1.21 struggle_iberia_ending_*_decision (03_fp2_decisions.txt):
#   Dominion = vanilla Hostility ending, Balance of Power = Compromise, Concord = Conciliation (takes the hegemony by agreement).
#   Collapse is automatic (cyber_kings_struggle_effects.txt). Not gated by has_fp2_dlc_trigger (test item).

##### Terra #####
ck_terra_ending_dominion_decision = {
	decision_group_type = major
	title = ck_terra_ending_dominion_decision
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/fp2_decision_struggle_hostility.dds"
	}
	extra_picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/struggle_decision_buttons/fp2_decision_hostility.dds"
	desc = ck_terra_ending_dominion_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = ck_terra_ending_dominion_decision_tooltip
	confirm_click_sound = "event:/DLC/FP2/SFX/UI/fp2_struggle_ending_decision_confirm"
	is_invisible = yes	# shown in the struggle window (vanilla pattern)
	sort_order = 80
	cooldown = { days = 1 }

	is_shown = {
		is_landless_adventurer = no
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_capable_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	is_valid = {
		top_liege = this
		exists = struggle:ck_struggle_terra
		OR = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = ck_terra_ending_dominion_decision_correct_phase_tt
				struggle:ck_struggle_terra ?= { is_struggle_phase = ck_terra_phase_hostility }
			}
			# vanilla: completely control the region with a long-held primary title
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = ck_terra_ending_dominion_decision_control_tt
				completely_controls_region = ckworld_earth
				primary_title = {
					tier >= tier_empire
					title_held_years >= 5
				}
			}
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_terra_ending_dominion_decision_share_tt
			value = ck_terra_dominion_counties
			ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth SHARE = ck_terra_dominion_counties }
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_terra_ending_dominion_decision_rival_tt
			value = ck_terra_rival_counties
			NOT = {
				any_independent_ruler = {
					this != root
					ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth SHARE = ck_terra_rival_counties }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		ck_terra_ending_dominion_effect = yes
		show_as_tooltip = {
			stress_and_fulfillment_impact = { arrogant = medium_stress_impact_gain }
		}
	}

	cost = {}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 120
		empire = 60
		hegemony = 60
	}

	ai_potential = { always = yes }

	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }
}

	decision_group_type = major

	}

	desc = ck_terra_ending_balance_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = ck_terra_ending_balance_decision_tooltip
	confirm_click_sound = "event:/DLC/FP2/SFX/UI/fp2_struggle_ending_decision_confirm"
	is_invisible = yes	# shown in the struggle window (vanilla pattern)
	sort_order = 80
	cooldown = { days = 1 }

	is_shown = {
		is_landless_adventurer = no
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_capable_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	is_valid = {
		top_liege = this
		exists = struggle:ck_struggle_terra
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = ck_terra_ending_balance_decision_correct_phase_tt
			struggle:ck_struggle_terra ?= { is_struggle_phase = ck_terra_phase_compromise }
		}
		OR = {
			prestige_level >= very_high_prestige_level
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_terra_ending_balance_decision_share_tt
			value = ck_terra_balance_max_counties
			NOT = { ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth SHARE = ck_terra_balance_max_counties } }
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_terra_ending_balance_decision_other_share_tt
			value = ck_terra_balance_max_counties
			NOT = {
				any_independent_ruler = {
					this != root
					ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth SHARE = ck_terra_balance_max_counties }
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = ck_terra_ending_general_peace_tt
			ck_struggle_general_peace_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth }
		}
		OR = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = ck_terra_ending_balance_decision_opinion_tt
				ck_struggle_great_powers_accept_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth OPINION = ck_struggle_balance_opinion }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = ck_terra_ending_balance_decision_no_rival_tt
				ck_struggle_no_other_great_power_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		ck_terra_ending_balance_effect = yes
		show_as_tooltip = {
			stress_and_fulfillment_impact = { arrogant = medium_stress_impact_gain }
		}
	}

	cost = {}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 120
		empire = 60
		hegemony = 60
	}

	ai_potential = { always = yes }

	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }
}

##### Luna #####
ck_luna_ending_dominion_decision = {
	decision_group_type = major
	title = ck_luna_ending_dominion_decision
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/fp2_decision_struggle_hostility.dds"
	}
	extra_picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/struggle_decision_buttons/fp2_decision_hostility.dds"
	desc = ck_luna_ending_dominion_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = ck_luna_ending_dominion_decision_tooltip
	confirm_click_sound = "event:/DLC/FP2/SFX/UI/fp2_struggle_ending_decision_confirm"
	is_invisible = yes	# shown in the struggle window (vanilla pattern)
	sort_order = 80
	cooldown = { days = 1 }

	is_shown = {
		is_landless_adventurer = no
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_capable_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	is_valid = {
		top_liege = this
		exists = struggle:ck_struggle_luna
		OR = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = ck_luna_ending_dominion_decision_correct_phase_tt
				struggle:ck_struggle_luna ?= { is_struggle_phase = ck_luna_phase_hostility }
			}
			# vanilla: completely control the region with a long-held primary title
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = ck_luna_ending_dominion_decision_control_tt
				completely_controls_region = ckbloc_luna
				primary_title = {
					tier >= tier_empire
					title_held_years >= 5
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = ck_luna_ending_dominion_decision_body_tt
			OR = {
				completely_controls_region = ckworld_moon
				completely_controls_region = ckworld_ceres
			}
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_luna_ending_dominion_decision_share_tt
			value = ck_luna_dominion_counties
			ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_luna SHARE = ck_luna_dominion_counties }
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_luna_ending_dominion_decision_rival_tt
			value = ck_luna_rival_counties
			NOT = {
				any_independent_ruler = {
					this != root
					ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_luna SHARE = ck_luna_rival_counties }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		ck_luna_ending_dominion_effect = yes
		show_as_tooltip = {
			stress_and_fulfillment_impact = { arrogant = medium_stress_impact_gain }
		}
	}

	cost = {}

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 120
		empire = 60
		hegemony = 60
	}

	ai_potential = { always = yes }

	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }
}

			value = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties
			NOT = { OR = { AND = { NOT = { root.faith = faith:zensunni } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:zensunni SHARE = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties } } AND = { NOT = { root.faith = faith:gnostic_faith } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:gnostic_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties } } AND = { NOT = { root.faith = faith:ancestor_worship_faith } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:ancestor_worship_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties } } AND = { NOT = { root.faith = faith:shia } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:shia SHARE = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties } } AND = { NOT = { root.faith = faith:kushitism_pagan } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:kushitism_pagan SHARE = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties } } AND = { NOT = { root.faith = faith:eternal_mechanism } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:eternal_mechanism SHARE = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties } } AND = { NOT = { root.faith = faith:theravada_faith } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:theravada_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties } } AND = { NOT = { root.faith = faith:reaverism_faith } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:reaverism_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties } } AND = { NOT = { root.faith = faith:rabbinic_faith } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:rabbinic_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_rival_faith_counties } } } }
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_jovian_ending_triumph_decision_power_tt
			value = ck_jovian_great_power_counties
			ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean SHARE = ck_jovian_great_power_counties }
